originals.citation: Fornage, M., Debette, S., et al. (2011). Genome-wide association studies of cerebral white matter lesion burden: the CHARGE consortium. Annals of Neurology.

quote: A recent genome-wide association study has successfully identified several genetic variations in the Chr17q25 locus as susceptible genotypes for white matter hyperintensities. We report the first replication study in subjects of non-European origin.
notes: Verhaaren 2011 is an earlier European replication in the chain; the paper frames itself as replicating the GWAS finding (rs3744028 was Fornage's lead SNP).
